rank1_gate: ControlRank1 tracking must be no worse than fitted Local tracking on the fresh-fleet mean.
rank2_gate: ControlRank2 must be within 1% of ExactIndividual tracking and use fewer than three local coordinates.
notes: Oracle structural gate before personalized FL. True family labels and true training/test ratios are deliberately used to isolate representation rank. ParameterPCA learns Euclidean log-parameter directions. ControlPCA learns family-specific directions under the local quadratic metric induced by scheduled LQI-gain sensitivity. Test coefficients are oracle projections of true unseen ratios; fitting those coefficients from finite local data is deferred. Rank 3 must reconstruct ExactIndividual numerically. Local uses the unchanged 9D finite-data fit as the practical accuracy comparator.
